## Background

- Helps run the technical side of UW's Kappa Theta Pi chapter.
- Certifications: CCNA (earned), CompTIA Security+ (in progress).

## Focus areas

- Cloud infrastructure
- Network engineering (TCP/IP, routing & switching, subnetting, DNS/DHCP, Wireshark)
- Cybersecurity (OWASP Top 10, RBAC, authentication and access control)
- Backend development, QA, IT/systems

## Projects

- aplyx (https://github.com/keshm2/aplyx): Local-first job-application agent
  that runs on top of an existing coding agent. Searches Ashby, Lever,
  Greenhouse, and Workday, dedupes against history, tailors a resume and cover
  letter per posting, applies, and reports outcomes to Discord and a Google
  Sheet. Python/TypeScript/React/Rust/PostgreSQL. Deterministic helpers own all
  state; the LLM only orchestrates; fail-closed on submit.
- UW KTP (https://github.com/UW-KTP/peaka-theta-pi): Chapter-management
  platform for UW's Kappa Theta Pi. Public rush site, member portal, admin
  console; dues via Stripe, attendance, points, and budgeting in one system of
  record. Next.js/React/TypeScript/Tailwind. Front-end demo live, backend next.
- kyper (https://github.com/keshm2/kyper): Fully offline RAG tool for asking
  questions about local PDFs. Python/Ollama/Llama 3/embeddings.
- HusKey Manager (https://github.com/keshm2/passwordmanager): Team password
  vault built for UW INFO 310 with intentionally vulnerable code for teaching
  auth, role permissions, and access-control bugs. PHP/MySQL/Docker.
- bots (https://github.com/keshm2/bots): General-purpose Discord bots for
  moderation and music. Python/Discord API/SQLite.
- ben: Discord chore-reminder bot in daily use by ~50 students. Python/Discord API.
